children: Transglobal Management Group, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue rising to $990084 while the company recorded a net loss of $5829465 and basic and diluted net loss per share of $(0.69), compared with revenue of $11040 a net loss of $948452 and EPS of $(0.24) in fiscal 2025.
Revenue was $990,084 for FY 2026, up from $11,040 in FY 2025 (increase of $979,044).
Net income: Net loss of $5,829,465 for FY 2026, compared with net loss of $948,452 in FY 2025.
Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted net loss per common share $(0.69) for FY 2026 vs $(0.24) for FY 2025.
Revenue growth was driven primarily by Stand By Golf bookings and cart rentals following strategic acquisitions.
The company shifted its core focus from media to golf technology after acquiring GetGolf and Stand By Golf, making a golf booking platform its principal business direction.
Transglobal obtained GETGOLF and Stand By Golf trademarks and related intellectual property to pursue branded consumer and B2B licensing opportunities.
Operational milestones include deployment of the Stand By Golf reservation, yield-management and course-operations platform and the start of tee-time inventory monetization.
Management plans to expand via SaaS licensing, white-label deals, course acquisitions, analytics, and loyalty/token initiatives.
